usap_600007.title: Adelie penguin chick counts 1997-2009
usap_600007.coverage_statement: Public README/catalog coverage is Cape Royds and Cape Crozier; Cape Bird is absent.
usap_600007.consequence: Cannot define the frozen Royds-Bird-Crozier performance predictor.

usap_600006.title: Adelie penguin chick measurements 1996-2009
usap_600006.coverage_statement: Public archive exposes Cape Crozier and Cape Royds chick-measurement files; no Cape Bird file is present.
usap_600006.consequence: Cannot define a three-colony whole-system predictor.

decision.frozen_fallback_retained: prior-year banded-breeder chick-presence index under ROSS_ISLAND_BANDED_BREEDER_PERFORMANCE_V1
decision.reason: The fallback was predeclared before Ross behavioral rows were opened, and all independent three-colony candidate sources fail on source coverage rather than on association with movement outcomes.

claim_boundary: Do not describe the fallback index as whole-colony reproductive success.
Do not shrink the primary choice analysis to Royds and Crozier to exploit USAP 600007 or 600006.
Do not use MAPPPD chick values because the pinned target-site audit contains no such records.
No Ross settlement outcome has been inspected in making this source decision.
